title: Keep low matrix rank separate from a small response-type profile
statement: A family indexed by all3-dimensional subspaces of F2^r has global rank r=O(log n) yet approximating it with c=o(number of blocks) response orbits forces Omega(n^2) off-block scalar errors.

requires: The specified Grassmannian block family and its volume-cubic primitive blocks
provides: A family indexed by all3-dimensional subspaces of F2^r has global rank r=O(log n) yet approximating it with c=o(number of blocks) response orbits forces Omega(n^2) off-block scalar errors.
assumptions: A response-type guarantee does not dominate every generic-rank guarantee
costs: Actual row-orbit separation delta and scalar-error lower bound are source-local
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: Small global rank does not imply few interchangeable response types.
